decided: When orbit commits on its own, it commits everything uncommitted in the project, including edits the user made by hand, not only the files orbit wrote.
alternatives: commit only the change's folder and the files the command says it wrote, leaving the user's other edits uncommitted
why: The commit lands on the pull request branch for this change, so the user's own edits there belong to it; leaving an edit behind, or missing a file the AI forgot to name, is the worse failure.
